entities.name: Methanol
observations: Standardized structure is CO; serves as the methyl alcohol component in esterification.

entities.name: 2-Fluoro-3-methylbenzoic acid
observations: Standardized structure is CC1=CC=CC(C(=O)O)=C1F, equivalently Cc1cccc(C(=O)O)c1F.
Contains an aromatic carboxylic acid suitable for conversion to a methyl ester.

entities.name: Thionyl chloride
observations: Standardized structure is O=S(Cl)Cl, formula SOCl2; activates carboxylic acids for esterification in methanol.

entities.name: Methyl 2-fluoro-3-methylbenzoate
observations: Predicted principal product has canonical-style SMILES COC(=O)c1cccc(C)c1F.
Assignment is supported by methanol esterification chemistry and an exact-substrate esterification analog; no exact ORD record for all three inputs was found.
